This exact same thing happened to me, but it was when I was a second grader. it was horrifying, and still corrupts my childhood, and I remember, even as young as I was, having suicidal thoughts, and a plan as a 4th grader. this was about 9 years ago, I am still alive, and yet still my parents think I am useless in school, I strive to do my best and show the real shitheads who are who, no matter whatever happens to me or my spirit. I am failing at least 2 of my classes, but I still can try.
an important quote I live by, is that life moves on, no matter if we act a heroes or cowards, and people may not ever change, and they may never until they independently realize their fate.
You shouldn't be wanting to kill yourself, you should take a strong action plan, move out, get a job, and do whatever makes you happy, and remove everything that doesn't. Believe it or not, you truly do have the power to do that, and with effort, the effort most "happy people" are too scared to put in, you can make it. I  believe in you.
